run_dqfd_on_bsuite: run the DQfD agent on a BSuite environment like deep_sea with demonstration data
create_make_network: create an MLP neural network with flatten and two hidden layers for action prediction
construct_dqfd_agent: construct a DQfD agent with environment spec, network, demonstration dataset, and learning rate
load_bsuite_environment: load a BSuite environment and record episode results to a CSV file
run_environment_loop: run an Acme EnvironmentLoop with the agent and environment for a set number of episodes
